lines: Wave after wave they ran up the slope, through the fire, and took the factory on the top.
On the top stands a dead tree. It is not a tree. It is steel, painted like bark, and a spotter sits inside it.
For three days he watches every move in the Concord trenches. Hegemony snipers and machine gunners will shoot straighter for it.
Now the race for Blackwater Canal begins. This time it is not about recruits. The first side to kill one hundred enemy soldiers takes it.
Comment HEGEMONY or CONCORD to enlist. Every rifle counts.
Mud and Iron. Every follower is a soldier.
